title: Good subscription service for hair care
text: I think this is a good subscription service for any woman that is looking to try various hair care products. I’ve only received two (2j boxes and both had nice full size variety products but mainly for hair. I’m not a hair product junky so I don't want to fill my cabinet with a bunch of hair products. I was looking for more beauty products. From what I gather, this subscription does more hair care with some beauty trial products thrown in, which isn’t a bad thing, just not my thing.
label: neutral
